<issue_description>
A stack-based buffer overflow in the PDF CMap parsing code: pdf_parse_bf_range_array (source/pdf/pdf-cmap-parse.c) can cause pdf_map_one_to_many to read past the end of a converted buffer when handling multi-character mappings. This out‑of‑bounds access can lead to crashes and memory corruption, and may be exploitable when processing crafted PDF CMap data.
